additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390632-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P0 170001107] Router Issue CRM:00643001083
additional_info.body:
Hi
Bastien,
We have analyzed the logs and checked the charger’s router remotely. We found that the SIM was already inserted, but the connection was established via Wi-Fi. Additionally, WAN failover was enabled. We have made the necessary changes, and the OCPP backend is now back online.
Please let us know if you have any further questions. If not, we will proceed with closing this ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
